scope: Whole archived guide and pinned HTML; source interpretation, not human/server verification

1.original_instruction: Inside the central building (mid_camp 215, 247) at the camp, talk to Hibba Agip who is on the north side of the table in the center (mid_campin 90, 114), he and Abidail discuss your accomplishments.
1.short_ru: Поговорите с Hibba Agip: mid_camp 215, 247 → mid_campin 90, 114.
1.short_en: Talk to Hibba Agip: mid_camp 215, 247 → mid_campin 90, 114.
1.full_ru: В центральном здании лагеря (mid_camp 215, 247) поговорите с Hibba Agip с северной стороны стола (mid_campin 90, 114). Он и Abidail обсудят ваши достижения.
1.full_en: Inside the central building (mid_camp 215, 247) at the camp, talk to Hibba Agip who is on the north side of the table in the center (mid_campin 90, 114), he and Abidail discuss your accomplishments.

2.original_instruction: Talk to Staff Officer Abidail at the east end of the table, accept his request. He tells you to talk to Commander Agip.
2.short_ru: Примите просьбу Staff Officer Abidail и вернитесь к Commander Agip.
2.short_en: Accept Staff Officer Abidail’s request and return to Commander Agip.
2.full_ru: Поговорите с Staff Officer Abidail у восточного края стола и примите просьбу. Он направит к Commander Agip.
2.full_en: Talk to Staff Officer Abidail at the east end of the table, accept his request. He tells you to talk to Commander Agip.

3.original_instruction: Speak to Hibba Agip again, he gives you a document and asks you to speak to the messenger at at the dimensional gate.
3.short_ru: Получите document у Hibba Agip для посланника.
3.short_en: Receive the document from Hibba Agip for the messenger.
3.full_ru: Снова поговорите с Hibba Agip. Он передаст document и попросит отнести его посланнику у dimensional gate.
3.full_en: Speak to Hibba Agip again, he gives you a document and asks you to speak to the messenger at at the dimensional gate.

rewards.condition: Generic source label; exact inventory name and ID unknown.

4.original_instruction: Find Expedition Messenger (mid_camp 206, 286), while you are discussing the report, someone sneaks up and attempts to take it. If you attempt to safeguard the report from the attacker, it will be easier later to re-assemble the report later.
4.short_ru: Поговорите с Expedition Messenger: mid_camp 206, 286; постарайтесь защитить отчёт.
4.short_en: Talk to Expedition Messenger: mid_camp 206, 286; try to safeguard the report.
4.full_ru: Найдите Expedition Messenger (mid_camp 206, 286). Во время обсуждения отчёта неизвестный попытается его похитить. Попытка защитить отчёт облегчит последующее восстановление.
4.full_en: Find Expedition Messenger (mid_camp 206, 286), while you are discussing the report, someone sneaks up and attempts to take it. If you attempt to safeguard the report from the attacker, it will be easier later to re-assemble the report later.

actions.condition: Source says this makes later restoration easier; exact effect and menu text are not stated.

5.original_instruction: Return to Hibba Agip to inform him that the report has been destroyed. He tells you to go find the pieces of it.
5.short_ru: Сообщите Hibba Agip об уничтожении отчёта.
5.short_en: Inform Hibba Agip that the report was destroyed.
5.full_ru: Вернитесь к Hibba Agip и сообщите об уничтожении отчёта. Он попросит найти его части.
5.full_en: Return to Hibba Agip to inform him that the report has been destroyed. He tells you to go find the pieces of it.

6.original_instruction: Staff Officer Abidail asks you to bring him pages of the report in increments of 10.
6.short_ru: Приносите Staff Officer Abidail pages партиями по 10.
6.short_en: Bring pages to Staff Officer Abidail in batches of 10.
6.full_ru: Staff Officer Abidail попросит приносить pages отчёта порциями по 10.
6.full_en: Staff Officer Abidail asks you to bring him pages of the report in increments of 10.

items.condition: Per restoration attempt, not a guaranteed four-attempt quest total.

7.original_instruction: Speak to any of the Expedition Scout on the New World field maps, the scout will start looking for pages. Return every 30 minutes (15 minutes if you are playing on iRO instead). Scout locations are: (spl_fild02 296, 369) (north wall) (spl_fild03 172, 71) (south wall) (man_fild01 316, 92) (southeast) (man_fild03 202, 251) (east wall, halfway up) Pages can also be found when killing specific quest summoned monsters on the fields. (usually at one of several fixed spawn points)
7.short_ru: Запустите поиск у любого Expedition Scout: ожидание 30 минут, на iRO — 15; pages также выпадают с quest summoned monsters.
7.short_en: Start a search with any Expedition Scout: wait 30 minutes, or 15 on iRO; pages also drop from quest summoned monsters.
7.full_ru: Поговорите с любым Expedition Scout на полях New World, чтобы начать поиск pages. Возвращайтесь каждые 30 минут, а на iRO — каждые 15 минут. Точки разведчиков: spl_fild02 296, 369 у северной стены; spl_fild03 172, 71 у южной стены; man_fild01 316, 92 на юго-востоке; man_fild03 202, 251 у середины восточной стены. Pages также можно получить с особых quest summoned monsters на полях, обычно в нескольких фиксированных местах появления.

8.original_instruction: After returning with 10 pages, Abidail will restore one of the four volumes of the report. Keep searching for pages until all the volumes are restored. There is a very high chance that the pages bring do not form a single volume, or that they form a volume you already have. You will lose 10 pages and must collect more. (On iRO, you only lose 5 pages instead) You will automatically fail and discard the pages if he manages to restore a volume of the report you already have on you. As such, you should put completed volumes in storage. The extra volumes of the report can be given to other players doing the quest.
8.short_ru: У Abidail повторяйте попытки с 10 pages до получения всех volumes; готовые тома убирайте на склад.
8.short_en: Repeat attempts with 10 pages at Abidail until all volumes are restored; store completed volumes.
8.full_ru: Принесите Abidail 10 pages: он попытается восстановить один из четырёх volumes. Продолжайте, пока не восстановите все volumes. Высока вероятность, что pages не образуют том или получится уже имеющийся том. При неудаче теряются 10 pages, а на iRO — только 5 pages. Если восстановлен том, который уже находится у вас, попытка автоматически провалится и pages будут отброшены. Храните готовые volumes на складе; лишние volumes можно передавать другим игрокам, проходящим квест.
8.full_en: After returning with 10 pages, Abidail will restore one of the four volumes of the report. Keep searching for pages until all the volumes are restored. (On iRO, you only lose 5 pages instead) You will automatically fail and discard the pages if he manages to restore a volume of the report you already have on you. As such, you should put completed volumes in storage. The extra volumes of the report can be given to other players doing the quest.

reviews.detail: Pinned article has no database links. Generic document/pages/volumes/report labels and First Aid Kit have unknown game IDs here; delivery-copy counts and exact restoration probabilities are not invented.
Scout interval and failed-page loss have separate source-default and iRO branches. Ten pages per attempt does not guarantee success or a forty-page total. Completed volumes must be distinct.
